resources.string: This network’s MTU is %1$d. Direct connections need %2$d: large packets can be lost, relayed ones are not affected.

Tailscale wraps each packet in WireGuard, which adds up to 80 bytes. Where the network cannot carry that in one piece, the pieces are often dropped: small requests work, big answers over a direct path never arrive, while relayed traffic is fine. The setting belongs to the network or the host, not to the app: another VPN on the same computer, a virtual machine’s adapter. Raising the interface’s MTU to 1500 fixes it.
